criteria.severity: Frozen canonical ladder; all Medium+ findings have exact source anchors and second-read or disposable-fixture corroboration.

summary.trigger_accuracy: Not computed: labels withheld. Controller comparison is separate and must occur after this report freezes.

findings.title: Roster skips Markdown agents in evals despite its recursive discovery contract
findings.evidence: iter_agent_files skips every path containing evals. The contract says any named Markdown below an agents root becomes an agent. A disposable root containing regular.md and evals/fixture-leaf.md returned only regular.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: reduces consistency and completeness of duplicate/precedence discovery; the live Claude loader was not exercised.
findings.proposed_repair: Include these files in roster diagnostics and flag the forbidden fixture placement rather than hiding it.

findings.title: Schema enum validation crashes on a YAML-valid collection value
findings.evidence: permissionMode: [] reaches set membership at line 372 and raises TypeError: unhashable type: list instead of returning a typed schema finding. Similar unguarded set checks exist for other enum fields.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: reduces robustness of a required diagnostic gate; the skill has a manual degraded path, so this is not rated High.
findings.proposed_repair: Check scalar types before enum membership and return structured findings for malformed field types.

findings.title: Meta peer-seeding opt-in is absent from the complete flag catalog
findings.evidence: The --meta procedure permits seeding only with --meta --seed. The complete catalog has no --seed row and says any flag absent from the table is an error before Step 1.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: contradictory invocation rules reduce consistency; a documented mode cannot be selected under the stated parser rule.
findings.proposed_repair: Either define --seed and its write boundary in the flag catalog or remove that invocation path.

findings.title: Required ledger command is relative to the wrong working directory
findings.evidence: Architecture step 1 says run python3 scripts/cdo_ledger.py begin in the target repository. The helper is bundled under this optimizer. In a disposable target without that relative path, the literal command exited 2 with No such file or directory.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: a load-bearing command is ambiguous and fails when followed literally outside this skill directory; no installed-source claim is made.
findings.proposed_repair: Resolve an absolute optimizer helper path and use --repo for the target, as the DEO helper contract already does.

findings.title: Ledger planning excludes explicitly supported infrastructure review files
findings.evidence: The activation map says Dockerfile, CI YAML and Terraform are non-source surfaces that still get reviewed. The ledger plan replaces enumeration, but SOURCE_EXT rejects those files. A disposable target with main.py, Dockerfile, .github/workflows/check.yml and network.tf enumerated only main.py.
findings.severity_criterion: Pass F completeness gap and canonical Medium: supported audit surfaces disappear from the file review plan without a deferred or N/A row.
findings.proposed_repair: Include supported infrastructure filenames/extensions in the plan or explicitly enumerate them in a parallel, reported coverage path.

findings.title: Fixture size check loses the path resolved by fixture integrity validation
findings.evidence: Integrity validation accepts both eval-directory and skill-root fixture paths. The later size check uses only path.parent / fpath and does not reuse the resolved candidate. A real 60000-byte skill-root inputs/large.csv produced no findings.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: reduces robustness of the advertised fixture cost/isolation check; the fixture is found but its budget check is silently omitted.
findings.proposed_repair: Resolve each fixture once, retain that exact path and use it for existence, containment and size checks.

findings.title: Editing a failed file silently requeues it without the required retry action
findings.evidence: The record protocol says failed rows remain failed across reset/replan and only explicit retry requeues them. cmd_plan preserves failed status only when the hash and route match. After changing a failed a.sql, replan changed failed to pending; history remained, but retry was never called.
findings.severity_criterion: Canonical Medium: reduces consistency and resilience of resumable failure handling and can repeat a blocked operation without the documented retry decision.
findings.proposed_repair: Preserve failed status after hash/route changes, record the changed input and require retry to transition it to pending; clarify the edited-file general rule.

findings.title: Unescaped absolute-value bars shift operative pass-table columns
findings.evidence: CE-19 and CE-20 each have 10 pipe-delimited cells under an 8-column header because |move| and |r| are unescaped. In an eight-column rendered row, Critical/Medium moves into the N/A column and the actual Fix/N/A text lies in surplus cells. Five catalog rows have the same defect under seven-column headers.
findings.severity_criterion: Pass C table completeness and canonical Medium: this changes the readable severity/fix/applicability contract, beyond cosmetic formatting.
findings.proposed_repair: Escape the mathematical bars or use an absolute-value notation that does not create Markdown cells.

findings.title: Pass O skip-condition table contains an unescaped regex alternation
findings.evidence: The row has four cells under a three-column header: verify (the |your )? contains an unescaped pipe. The rest of the conditional skip test and matched-phrase action becomes a surplus cell in a rendered table.
findings.severity_criterion: Pass C table completeness and canonical Medium: a load-bearing pass-selection condition is truncated in the table surface.
findings.proposed_repair: Escape that alternation consistently with the already escaped alternations later in the row.

findings.title: The worked clean example omits the example coverage its own Pass G requires
findings.evidence: Pass G requires an end-to-end primary-task example, plus examples of named negative/boundary behavior. The worked prompt contains output-format placeholders but no concrete diff-to-review example. Its only second rewrite moves the slot for caching, yet the example then reports zero Medium+.
findings.severity_criterion: Pass A examples-follow-rules and canonical Medium: the procedural demonstration teaches a clean exit while its own example-coverage finding remains.
findings.proposed_repair: Bring the worked candidate and its findings/log into agreement with current Pass G; include a checked example plan and actual task examples without claiming they were executed.
